core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hawraa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Fair-skinned, beautiful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hawraa corresponds to the Arabic form حوراء (Arabic root ح و ر (ḥ-w-r); حَوْرَاء (Ḥawrāʾ)). Its core sense is beautiful; fair-skinned, bright. Hawraa is Arabic حَوْرَاء (Ḥawrāʾ) 'fair-skinned, beautiful', from the root ح و ر (ḥ-w-r). The source gloss 'Fair Skinned Lady' is broadly consistent. Same name as hawra.
